instruction: Create the shared join affordance. Export TWO things. (1) `joinableConference(conference, isSaved)` returning Conference|null: null unless isSaved AND conference?.url is present AND `new URL(url).protocol` is http: or https: (wrap in try/catch, return null on throw). This is the single gate both cards call so the all-day padding reservation can never disagree with what renders. (2) `EventJoinIcon` component with props { baseColor: string; conference: Conference; hasRepeatIcon: boolean; title?: string | null }. It renders an <a> with: `data-calendar-event-interactive="true"` (REQUIRED - this is the attribute the grid interaction adapters use to skip drag-target resolution), aria-label, href=conference.url, target="_blank", rel="noopener noreferrer", style={{ zIndex: ZIndex.LAYER_5 }}, className via `cn("c-focus-ring absolute bottom-0.5 flex h-3 w-3 items-center justify-center", hasRepeatIcon ? "right-4" : "right-1")`, plus React handlers `onMouseDown={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}` and `onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") e.stopPropagation(); }}`. Child: <VideoCameraIcon aria-hidden="true" className={getInteractiveIconClassName()} color={theme.getContrastText(baseColor)} size={12} weight="bold" />. Accessible name: `Join ${title?.trim() || "Untitled event"}` and when conference.label is set `Join ${eventTitle} via ${conference.label}`. Do NOT preventDefault anywhere. Do NOT use useEffect or native addEventListener. Do NOT add a click handler. Include a docstring in the tone of EventRepeatIcon's, explaining the one-place rule, why this cannot use pointer-events-none (it is a real focusable link), why the http(s) guard exists (z.url() does not constrain scheme), and why the data-calendar-event-interactive attribute is load-bearing.
